# ScriptItemStack

*Common*

Item stack: an item type, a count and its data (name, lore, enchantments, NBT), from inventories or created by

`scram.item(...)`. [`EMPTY`](#empty) is the empty stack.

## Methods

### getMinecraftItemStack {#getminecraftitemstack}

::: member

**Returns** `ItemStack` — the Minecraft item stack this wrapper changes, for Java code

:::

### isEmpty {#isempty}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the stack holds no items (air or a count of 0)

:::

### copy {#copy}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptItemStack`](/scripting/common/item/ScriptItemStack) — new stack with the same item, count and NBT; changing it does not change this one

:::

### getItem {#getitem}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptItem`](/scripting/common/item/ScriptItem) — the item type of the stack, like a diamond sword

:::

### getMaxCount {#getmaxcount}

::: member

**Returns** [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) — how many items of this kind fit in one stack, usually 64, 16 or 1

:::

### getCount {#getcount}

::: member

**Returns** [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) — number of items in the stack; 0 for an empty stack

:::

### setCount {#setcount}

::: member

Sets the number of items; 0 or less empties the stack. A count above [`getMaxCount()`](#getmaxcount) is kept, but inventories split such stacks.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | number of items |

:::

### addEnchantment {#addenchantment}

::: member

Adds an enchantment, even one that does not fit the item, keeping enchantments already there.

```js
c.getPlayer().getMainItem().addEnchantment("minecraft:sharpness", 5);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enchantment` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | enchantment ID; without a namespace it is `minecraft` |
| `level` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | enchantment level, from 1 |

:::

### getEnchantments {#getenchantments}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptNbtList`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtList) — the enchantments as an NBT list of compounds with `id` and `lvl`; changes to it change the stack, unless the stack has no enchantments (then the list is new and not stored)

:::

### isEnchantable {#isenchantable}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether an enchanting table can enchant the stack: an enchantable item without enchantments

:::

### getId {#getid}

::: member

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — ID of the item, like `"minecraft:diamond_sword"`

:::

### hasData {#hasdata}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the stack has NBT data, like a custom name, enchantments or damage

:::

### getData {#getdata}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptNbtCompound`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtCompound) — copy of the stack's NBT data (the `tag` part); change it and pass it to [`setData(ScriptNbtCompound)`](#setdata)

:::

### setData {#setdata}

::: member

Replaces the stack's NBT data with a copy. Ignored for an empty stack.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | [`ScriptNbtCompound`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtCompound) | NBT data, or null to remove it |

:::

### serialize {#serialize}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptNbtCompound`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtCompound) — the whole stack as NBT, with `id`, `Count` and `tag`; `scram.createItemFromNbt(nbt)` restores it

:::

### getDisplayName {#getdisplayname}

::: member

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — shown name: the custom name if set, otherwise the item's name

:::

### setDisplayName {#setdisplayname}

::: member

Sets a custom name. Ignored for an empty stack.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `Any` | [`ScriptText`](/scripting/common/ScriptText) (keeps its style) or any value shown as plain text; null or an empty string removes it |

:::

### getLoreList {#getlorelist}

::: member

**Returns** `List<String>` — lore lines as plain text

:::

### getLore {#getlore}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `index` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | line number, from 0 |

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — lore line as plain text, or an empty string if there is no such line

:::

### setLore {#setlore}

::: member

Sets a lore line; lines up to it are added as empty lines if needed. Ignored for an empty stack.

```js
var sword = scram.item("minecraft:iron_sword");

sword.setLore(0, scram.text("Forged in the depths").color("gray"));
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `index` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | line index, from 0 |
| `lore` | `Any` | [`ScriptText`](/scripting/common/ScriptText) (keeps its style) or any value shown as plain text |

:::

### addLore {#addlore}

::: member

Adds a lore line at the end. Ignored for an empty stack.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lore` | `Any` | [`ScriptText`](/scripting/common/ScriptText) (keeps its style) or any value shown as plain text |

:::

### clearLore {#clearlore}

::: member

Removes a lore line; the following lines move up.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `index` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | line number, from 0; a missing line is ignored |

:::

### clearAllLores {#clearalllores}

::: member

Removes all lore lines.

:::

### clearAllEnchantments {#clearallenchantments}

::: member

Removes all enchantments.

:::

### getCanDestroyBlocks {#getcandestroyblocks}

::: member

**Returns** `List<String>` — IDs of the blocks this stack can break in adventure mode

:::

### addCanDestroyBlock {#addcandestroyblock}

::: member

Lets this stack break the block in adventure mode. Ignored for an empty stack.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `block` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | block ID, like `"minecraft:stone"`, or a block tag like `"#minecraft:logs"` |

:::

### clearCanDestroyBlock {#clearcandestroyblock}

::: member

Stops this stack from breaking the block in adventure mode.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `block` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | block ID, like `"minecraft:stone"` |

:::

### clearAllCanDestroyBlocks {#clearallcandestroyblocks}

::: member

Removes all blocks this stack can break in adventure mode.

:::

### getCanPlaceOnBlocks {#getcanplaceonblocks}

::: member

**Returns** `List<String>` — IDs of the blocks this stack can be placed on in adventure mode

:::

### addCanPlaceOnBlock {#addcanplaceonblock}

::: member

Lets this stack be placed on the block in adventure mode. Ignored for an empty stack.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `block` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | block ID, like `"minecraft:stone"`, or a block tag like `"#minecraft:logs"` |

:::

### clearCanPlaceOnBlock {#clearcanplaceonblock}

::: member

Stops this stack from being placed on the block in adventure mode.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `block` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | block ID, like `"minecraft:stone"` |

:::

### clearAllCanPlaceOnBlocks {#clearallcanplaceonblocks}

::: member

Removes all blocks this stack can be placed on in adventure mode.

:::

### getRepairCost {#getrepaircost}

::: member

**Returns** [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) — experience levels added to the cost of using this stack in an anvil

:::

### setRepairCost {#setrepaircost}

::: member

Sets the extra levels an anvil charges for working on the stack. Ignored for an empty stack.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cost` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | extra experience levels |

:::

### isUnbreakable {#isunbreakable}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the stack never loses durability

:::

### setUnbreakable {#setunbreakable}

::: member

Makes the stack lose no durability when used, or breakable again. Ignored for an empty stack.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `isUnbreakable` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether the stack is unbreakable |

:::

### add {#add}

::: member

Changes the count; a negative amount removes items, and the stack becomes empty at 0. Ignored for an empty stack.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `amount` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | items to add, negative to remove |

:::

### isEqual {#isequal}

::: member

Compares stacks; named apart from `equals`, because `equals(null)` would match both overloads in scripts.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stack` | [`ScriptItemStack`](/scripting/common/item/ScriptItemStack) | stack to compare, or null |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether both stacks have the same item, count and NBT data; false for null

:::
